description: This file manages boot configuration for Zyxel devices, including reading, writing, and parsing image status and active image settings via MTD devices.

classes.name: zyxel_bootconfig
classes.description: Represents the boot configuration with image statuses and active image index.

classes.name: zyxel_bootconfig_mtd
classes.description: Encapsulates MTD device info and file descriptor for operations.

classes.name: zyxel_image_status
classes.description: Associates image status codes with their string names.

methods.name: zyxel_bootconfig_image_status_parse
methods.description: Parses a string to its corresponding image status enum.

methods.name: zyxel_bootconfig_image_status_name
methods.description: Returns the string name of an image status enum.

methods.name: zyxel_bootconfig_mtd_close
methods.description: Closes the MTD device file descriptor.

methods.name: zyxel_bootconfig_mtd_open
methods.description: Opens an MTD device and retrieves its info.

methods.name: zyxel_bootconfig_read
methods.description: Reads the boot configuration from the MTD device.

methods.name: zyxel_bootconfig_write
methods.description: Writes the boot configuration to the MTD device.

methods.name: zyxel_bootconfig_print_usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line tool.
